verdict.rationale: GitBook documents a first-party 'Content variants' feature under site structure, which points to multiple variants of content within one published site. The pack contains only the page title, though, so per-version publishing and a reader-facing version switcher are implied rather than shown. The 'Version control' item is edit/change history, which is adjacent and not credited. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that variants represent product or API versions, evidence of a reader-facing version switcher on the published site, per-API-version OpenAPI handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I publish versioned documentation per product or API version, and readers switch versions from the site
